serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Lady Annalie: Do I really need to wear this helmet? My hair will smell bad if I wear it!
Bot: You need to wear one, that’s the rules.
Lady Annalie: Can’t I just-
Bot: No.
Melissa: No.
Lady Annalie: Geez, fine.
…
According to {f_botName} we were able to secure 2 fastest go-karts.
Our best drivers, Melissa and {f_botName} got them so that they can easily secure 2 first places. 
It was decided that the first place will get 7 points, second 6 and so on. It means that to win, I or Annalie need to get at least 6th place. 
Alright, I need to focus now. The race starts in 3…{{wi}}2…{{wi}}...1!
My start wasn’t the best, but at least I’m not last. 
{f_botName} and Melissa are already behind the corner so I can’t tell what places they have. 
Annalie seems to be behind me, but I can’t spare time to look around.
Damn…{{wi}} These guys are good. My lines are not good enough and the guy behind me keeps pressuring me… {{wi}}If I make one bad decision he will overtake me!
That’s one lap out of 3. Things seem to look good. I think I’m currently in 5th place.
Oh! Someone is stuck on the barricades! That will put me in 4th place!
…
Never mind… {{wi}}That was just Annalie…
Shit!{{punch}} I lost concentration just for a second and one of the men already took advantage of it! I’m 6th now!
It doesn't look good. If one of the bots makes a mistake we will lose!
I don’t have the time to worry about them. I have a bigger problem behind me.
His go-kart seems slower than mine and that’s the only thing that keeps me in the lead.
On every corner he cuts away a chunk of distance between us.
If this keeps up I don’t think I will finish ahead of him!
Last lap…{{wi}} things aren’t looking good!
He’s on my tail and just waiting for a time to strike. So far I’m blocking him well, but there’s just too much difference in abilities! 
I’m about to pass by Annalie again.
Wait! That’s it! If I block vision of the guy behind me, he might crash into her!
I need to try, that’s the only way! Sorry, Annalie!
{{punch}}Yes! It worked! With that our win should be secured!
